26 * Centralising this here keeps the REST controllers thin: they delegate to 27 * {@link #householdKey(String, String)} both when deciding whether a new owner shares a 28 * household with an existing one and (in future) when deriving the shared household 29 * identifier, so the two always agree on what "the same household" means. 30 *

31 * Two owners belong to the same household when they have the same last name and the same 32 * address. Both fields are compared case-insensitively after trimming and collapsing runs 33 * of whitespace to a single space, so values that differ only in letter case or in 34 * incidental spacing map to the same key. The normalized fields are joined with a newline, 35 * which the normalization can never itself produce, so the key uniquely determines the 36 * (last name, address) pair it was built from. 37 */ 38 @Component 39 public class HouseholdNormalizer { 40 41 /** 42 * Builds the canonical household key for the given last name and address. Owners whose 43 * last name and address normalize identically share a key and therefore a household. 44 * 45 * @param lastName the owner's last name (may be {@code null}) 46 * @param address the owner's address (may be {@code null}) 47 * @return the canonical household key 48 */ 49 public String householdKey(String lastName, String address) { 50 return normalizeField(lastName) + '\n' + normalizeField(address); 51 } 52 53 /** 54 * Derives the stable shared identifier for the household with the given last name and 55 * address. The identifier is a pure function of the canonical {@link #householdKey key}, 56 * so every owner in the same household derives the identical value and it never changes 57 * between calls (a "stable shared identifier"). It is formatted 'HH-' followed by the 58 * first 12 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the household key, hashed via the 59 * shared {@link Sha256Hex} helper so every hash-derived identifier in the app is computed 60 * one way. 61 * 62 * @param lastName the owner's last name (may be {@code null}) 63 * @param address the owner's address (may be {@code null}) 64 * @return the stable household identifier 65 */ 66 public String householdId(String lastName, String address) { 67 return "HH-" + Sha256Hex.upperHexPrefix(householdKey(lastName, address), 12); 68 } 69 70 /** 71 * Normalizes a single household field by trimming, collapsing internal runs of 72 * whitespace to a single space and lower-casing, so comparisons ignore case and 73 * incidental whitespace differences. 74 * 75 * @param value the value to normalize (may be {@code null}) 76 * @return the normalized value, or the empty string if the input was {@code null} 77 */ 78 private String normalizeField(String value) { 79 if (value == null) { 80 return ""; 81 } 82 return value.trim().replaceAll("\\s+", " ").toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT); 83 } 84 } 85

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must carry 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'. It is then stored and returned in that E.164 form (e.g.
            '0412 345 678' becomes '+61412345678'). A value that cannot form
            valid E.164 is rejected with 400.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]+$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must
            be valid for the owner's city per the fixed region ranges
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099 for cities in the
            Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD table); a city with no
            known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. A malformed or
            out-of-range postcode is rejected with 400. It is stored and
            returned unchanged.
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When omitted on create the server sets it to its current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'
            (computed against the registration date).
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner already
            has the same last name and address (i.e. they share a household).
            Write-only; it is not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The pet owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The pet owner's customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where
                REGION is the region derived from the postcode (falling back to the
                city) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the
                SHA-256 digest over the normalized telephone concatenated with the
                last name. Carries no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-A1B2C3D4'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the decimal
                digits contained in the customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 5
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                The stable identifier shared by all owners of the same household
                (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is created
                with 'sharesHousehold' true and joins an existing household; the
                joining owner and the existing household members all carry the
                same value. Absent for owners that do not share a household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The derived key used for duplicate detection, formed as the
                normalized telephone, the lower-cased email (or empty when
                absent) and the household id (or empty when absent) joined with
                '|'. A new owner is rejected with 409 Conflict only when its
                whole identity key equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared the same first and
                last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner
                was created. Assigned once at creation and returned unchanged.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the registration date's year
                (e.g. 'NSW-A1B2C3D4-M26'). Assigned once at creation and returned
                unchanged.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-A1B2C3D4-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The pet owner's numeric membership level from 1 to 3, derived at
                creation: it starts at 1, gains 1 when an email address is
                present, gains 1 when the namesake count is 0, and is capped at 3
                (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region taken from the REGION segment of the owner's
                customer code (the region derived from the postcode, falling back
                to the city), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves to a known region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's registration date at the moment this owner was created.
                Assigned once at creation and returned unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether this owner, though not a hard duplicate, shares an
                existing owner's last name and postcode while carrying a
                different telephone. Assigned once at creation and returned
                unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate
                of (shared last name and postcode, different telephone), or
                absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false. Assigned once at
                creation and returned unchanged.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The pet owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the
                stored contact details: 'EMAIL' when an email address is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The pet owner's age band derived from the birth date, computed
                against the registration date: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT'
                when 18 to 64, and 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when no
                birth date is present.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

      required:

      title: Validation message

    Specialty:
      title: Specialty

    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must carry 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'. It is then stored and returned in that E.164 form (e.g.
            '0412 345 678' becomes '+61412345678'). A value that cannot form
            valid E.164 is rejected with 400.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]+$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must
            be valid for the owner's city per the fixed region ranges
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099 for cities in the
            Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD table); a city with no
            known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. A malformed or
            out-of-range postcode is rejected with 400. It is stored and
            returned unchanged.
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When omitted on create the server sets it to its current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'
            (computed against the registration date).
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner already
            belongs to the same household (same last name and postcode, and
            therefore the same household id); it only bypasses the household
            duplicate block and the owner is created as a declared household
            member (never flagged as a possible duplicate). Write-only; it is
            not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:

        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-

              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The pet owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The pet owner's customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where
                REGION is the region derived from the postcode (falling back to the
                city) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the
                SHA-256 digest over the normalized telephone concatenated with the
                last name. Carries no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-A1B2C3D4'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the decimal
                digits contained in the customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 5
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                The stable identifier shared by all owners of the same household
                (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is created
                with 'sharesHousehold' true and joins an existing household; the
                joining owner and the existing household members all carry the
                same value. Absent for owners that do not share a household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The derived key used for duplicate detection, formed as the
                normalized telephone, the lower-cased email (or empty when
                absent) and the household id (or empty when absent) joined with
                '|'. A new owner is rejected with 409 Conflict only when its
                whole identity key equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared the same first and
                last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner
                was created. Assigned once at creation and returned unchanged.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the registration date's year
                (e.g. 'NSW-A1B2C3D4-M26'). Assigned once at creation and returned
                unchanged.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-A1B2C3D4-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The pet owner's numeric membership level from 1 to 3, derived at
                creation: it starts at 1, gains 1 when an email address is
                present, gains 1 when the namesake count is 0, and is capped at 3
                (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region taken from the REGION segment of the owner's
                customer code (the region derived from the postcode, falling back
                to the city), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves to a known region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:

              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-

                existing owner's last name and postcode while carrying a
                different telephone. Assigned once at creation and returned
                unchanged.

              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:

              readOnly: true

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must carry 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'. It is then stored and returned in that E.164 form (e.g.
            '0412 345 678' becomes '+61412345678'). A value that cannot form
            valid E.164 is rejected with 400.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]+$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must
            be valid for the owner's city per the fixed region ranges
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099 for cities in the
            Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD table); a city with no
            known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. A malformed or
            out-of-range postcode is rejected with 400. It is stored and
            returned unchanged.
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When omitted on create the server sets it to its current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'
            (computed against the registration date).
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner already
            belongs to the same household (same last name and postcode, and
            therefore the same household id); it only bypasses the household
            duplicate block and the owner is created as a declared household
            member (never flagged as a possible duplicate). Write-only; it is
            not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The pet owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of the
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The pet owner's customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where
                REGION is the region derived from the postcode (falling back to the
                city) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the
                SHA-256 digest over the normalized telephone concatenated with the
                last name. Carries no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-A1B2C3D4'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the decimal
                digits contained in the customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 5
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                The deterministic identifier shared by all owners of the same
                household (same last name and postcode), computed as the first
                12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized last name and
                the postcode joined with '|'. Every owner with the same last name
                and postcode carries the same value automatically; it is always
                assigned.
              type: string
              example: '1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The derived key used for duplicate detection, formed as the
                normalized telephone, the lower-cased email (or empty when
                absent) and the household id (or empty when absent) joined with
                '|'. A new owner is rejected with 409 Conflict only when its
                whole identity key equals an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared the same first and
                last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner
                was created. Assigned once at creation and returned unchanged.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the registration date's year
                (e.g. 'NSW-A1B2C3D4-M26'). Assigned once at creation and returned
                unchanged.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-A1B2C3D4-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The pet owner's numeric membership level from 1 to 3, derived at
                creation: it starts at 1, gains 1 when an email address is
                present, gains 1 when the namesake count is 0, and is capped at 3
                (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region taken from the REGION segment of the owner's
                customer code (the region derived from the postcode, falling back
                to the city), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves to a known region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's registration date at the moment this owner was created.
                Assigned once at creation and returned unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether this owner, though not a hard duplicate, shares an
                existing owner's last name and postcode while carrying a
                different telephone. Assigned once at creation and returned
                unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate
                of (shared last name and postcode, different telephone), or
                absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is false. Assigned once at
                creation and returned unchanged.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The pet owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the
                stored contact details: 'EMAIL' when an email address is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The pet owner's age band derived from the birth date, computed
                against the registration date: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT'
                when 18 to 64, and 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when no
                birth date is present.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## What I changed

The `householdId` is now **deterministic** — the first 12 hex chars of SHA-256 over `normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode` — so owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically, without any explicit linking step.

**`OwnerRestControllerV1`** (`addOwner` flow)
- `applyHouseholdMembership` now: (1) always assigns the computed `householdId`; (2) treats any existing owner with the same `householdId` as the same household — a second such owner is rejected **409** as a household duplicate **unless** `sharesHousehold` is set, in which case it's created as a *declared household member*; (3) records `householdSize` (members + 1). - `sharesHousehold` now only **bypasses the duplicate block** — the linking/back-fill logic (`linkToHousehold`) is gone since the id is deterministic.

- `assignPossibleDuplicate` skips flagging for a declared household member ("a declared member is not a suspected duplicate").

**New exception** `HouseholdDuplicateException` (extends `OwnerConflictException` → maps to 409).

**`openapi.yml`** — updated the now-stale `sharesHousehold`, `householdId`, and `possibleDuplicate` descriptions to match the new semantics.

One design note worth surfacing: I kept the pre-existing identity-key duplicate check in place alongside the new household-duplicate rule. Since `householdId` is now part of the identity key, an *exact* identity duplicate (same telephone + email + household) is still rejected 409 even with `sharesHousehold` set — `sharesHousehold` bypasses only the household block, not a fully-identical record.
